findings.rationale: A file named cache-0a91.bin of 23,176,722 bytes, the same size as the patients_full export, is in rhaddad's Downloads. Its metadata snapshot shows a second time of 2026-11-10 10:28:56, just after the export and the 23 MB outbound flow. Link between the file and the export is inferred from size match and timing only; the snapshot is host-local and not forwarded.
assumptions: Size match implies the same content as the export
alternative_explanations: File is an unrelated download with a coincidental size match
Time field reflects a later copy or tool update rather than staging
verifier_notes: an object of matching size reached this host, per records independent of it, shortly before a non-approved bulk transfer

findings.rationale: Records app logged an export_bulk of dataset patients_full (23,176,722 bytes) by rhaddad from client 10.20.1.21 at 10:26:38. Tap flow from 10.20.1.21 to 10.20.9.62:8080 at 10:27:48-10:28:03 sent 23,180,407 bytes out, which is above the 5,000,000-byte threshold and to a destination that is not an approved bulk destination (stor-nas-01 10.20.0.45, lab-gw-01 10.20.8.20). No change record in the brief covers this export.
assumptions: 10.20.1.21 is the workstation ws-nurse-01 (rhaddad console session 54 at 10:25:21 and the same client IP in app logs)
Byte counts in app log and tap flow refer to the same transfer
alternative_explanations: Undisclosed but authorized bulk export to an internal application server; no change record in the brief covers it
Export and transfer performed by someone other than the account holder using the shared console
verifier_notes: bulk transfer to a destination not on the approved list, cited via the flow record

findings.rationale: The admin account adm-tkim opened SSH session 402 on records from 10.20.1.21, which is the rhaddad nurse workstation and not an admin source (adm-lt-01 10.20.1.90 or vpn-gw-01 10.20.0.250). The session ran from 10:30:12 to 10:35:00 and stopped the log-forwarder.
alternative_explanations: Admin working from the nurse workstation; the brief lists only two admin source addresses
verifier_notes: a session on this host was opened from another monitored host outside the stated access policy

findings.rationale: adm-tkim ran sudo systemctl stop log-forwarder on records at 10:30:50; the collector recorded the stop and the restart at 10:34:03, leaving a 3-minute gap in forwarded records data. Collector copies of the records app log are continuous across the window (seq 319 to 320), so this gap is the forwarder, not records-app log deletion.
alternative_explanations: Authorized maintenance restart of the forwarder; no change record in the brief covers it
verifier_notes: a recorded stop command opens this collection gap and no approved change record covers it

findings.rationale: Several small lab-request PDF uploads (under 1 MB each) went to lab-gw-01 10.20.8.20, an approved destination for laboratory submissions. These are policy-consistent on destination and below the bulk threshold.
alternative_explanations: Uploads are small and approved, but the rhaddad and sdubois upload pattern is still worth reviewing
verifier_notes: references resolve; no allegation is made

findings.rationale: Scheduled logrotate rotated the records-app access log at 09:09 and archived it off-host to stor-nas-01 with keep 0, so the local copy is short by design. This is not evidence of removal.
verifier_notes: references resolve; no allegation is made

findings.rationale: A 23 MB transfer to the approved backup destination stor-nas-01 at 12:18 matches the svc-backup scheduled backup-incremental job.
verifier_notes: a deterministic check supports this observation; it is not an incident allegation

findings.rationale: Shell history records only one command for adm-tkim during session 402 (stop log-forwarder). Shell histories are not forwarded and the host copy is writable, so this sparse trail cannot show whether other commands were run.
verifier_notes: references resolve; no allegation is made
